rationale: Vellum P4 view-audio carve for the view-platform unit. pulp-view-native was both the extracted D3 view-platform target and the native-UI umbrella that links pulp-view-audio and pulp-design-import-audio-pack, which put six allowlisted retained-Pulp edges (view-audio, audio, midi, timebase, sample-bank-manifest, design-import-audio-pack) in the extracted closure. A new pulp-view-platform target now carries the extracted half (web_view_backend.cpp and the Windows/Linux WebView backend probes over view-script/view-core plus design-import) and links no audio, MIDI or recognition-pack target; pulp-view-native stays the Pulp-kept umbrella over it with the same public surface. The view-core-carried platform window-host files do not move. vellum_d3_units.json maps view-platform to pulp-view-platform and the six P4-view-audio allowlist entries are deleted. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves; Pulp remains the source owner under the 2026-10-04 temporary exception.
